user.title: Water heating system
user.description: Choose how domestic hot water is produced. WaterSteer uses this to select the appropriate control model.

data_description.system_type: Choose a standalone water heater or a heat pump with integrated domestic hot water.

sensors.title: Input sensors
sensors.description: Select the Home Assistant entities WaterSteer will use as its primary inputs.

data_description.dhw_temperature_entity: Sensor that represents the current domestic hot water temperature.
data_description.electricity_price_entity: Sensor that represents the current electricity price. Future price data will be added by the price planner.

standalone_control.title: Standalone water heater
standalone_control.description: Configure the relay or contactor used to enable the water heater. WaterSteer 0.1 only observes these inputs and does not switch the heater yet.

data_description.standalone_control_switch: Switch entity that controls the contactor, relay, or other enable signal for the standalone water heater.
data_description.standalone_power_sensor: Optional power sensor for the water heater. This can later help WaterSteer distinguish commanded operation from actual heating.

heat_pump_control.title: Heat pump domestic hot water
heat_pump_control.description: Configure the signals and actions available for domestic hot water control. These are stored for future WaterSteer control logic; version 0.1 does not execute them.

data_description.heat_pump_dhw_active_entity: Optional sensor or binary sensor that indicates whether the heat pump is currently producing domestic hot water.
data_description.heat_pump_boost_action: Optional Home Assistant action that actively requests domestic hot water production, for example Extra hot water, Temporary luxury, or DHW boost.
data_description.heat_pump_block_action: Optional Home Assistant action that blocks or disables normal domestic hot water production.
data_description.heat_pump_normal_action: Optional Home Assistant action that returns domestic hot water operation to its normal heat-pump setting.

options.standalone_water_heater: Standalone water heater (for example controlled by a contactor or relay)
options.heat_pump_integrated_dhw: Heat pump with integrated domestic hot water
